Gautama
father of Kṣemaśarmācārya (a. of Cikitsāsārasaṅgraha, BORI. D. XV. i. 75).

Gautama

--son of Vasubhūti; mentioned a. preceptor of Muni Brahman in his C. Jinahitā on the Daśāśrutaskandhasūtra.

Gautama
a gotra name of the Buddha.

Gautama

Gautama

Gautama
authority on elephant lore; mentioned by Pālakāpya in Hastyāyurveda (Ānandāśrama 26. p. 3); an. by Somadeva in Yaśastilakacampū (K. M. 70, Vol. I. p. 291).

Gautama
authority on cattle breading; mentioned by Kauṭalya in Arthaśāstra, TSS. edn. p. 32.

Gautama
one of the nine subdivisions of the Rāṇāyanīya school of Sv. according to a C. on Caraṇavyūha. Ved Mitra, India of Dharmasūtras intro. p. xxiii; also IO. ii. p. 33a.

Gautama

Gautama
authority on dh. belonging to the school of Sv.; earlier than Baudhāyana an. Vasiṣṭha who quote him; Sāmavidhāna Brāhmaṇa 1. 2 is incorporated in Gautamasmṛti (ch. 26).
--Gautamadharmasūtra. See below.
--Pitṛmedhasūtra. PUL. I. p. 94.
Ed. W. Caland, Leipzig, 1896.
--Kriyākāṇḍa or Āhnika (sūtra), a Pariśiṣṭa of G. dh. sūtra; in 18 chs. See NCC. II. p.. 255b, 243b; V. p. 131a.
Pt.. a. appendix to the Mysore edn. of the text. 1917.
--Praśna or Gautamadharmasūtra Pariśiṣṭa on Prāyaścitta in 500 sūtras divided into 20 sections,
Ed. Adyar Library, Madras, 1948.
Ref. to by Kumārila Bhaṭṭa in Tantravārttika on Sūtra 1. 3. 11. [Page223-b]
Gautama is considered to be the earliest dh. sūtra writer by G. Buhler (SBE. II. p.. IX-LVII an. XIV. XI-XLV); J. Jolly (Recht an. Sitte, p.. 2-7) an. Kane (HDS. I. p.. 12-60); Batakrishna Ghosh considered G. a. later than Āpastamba (IHQ. III. p.. 607-11); R. P. Kangle takes G. to be the youngest writer of dh. sūtras (Melanges d'indianisme, Louis Renou Vol. 1968, p.. 415-25).

Gautama
also called Akṣapāda, authority on Nyāyaśāstra: so ref. to also in Mahābhārata, Śanti Parvan, I. ii. 34. nyAyazAstraM hi kArtsnyena gautamo veda tatvataH; earlier than Nāgārjuna who quotes an. criticises the Nyāyasūtra in his Vigrahavyāvartinī an. Vaidalyaprakaraṇa. (See J.. Vol. 215, 2-3 an. Shukyo-Kenkya. (Etudes sur les religions). New Series, IV. 2 an. 3); also criticized by Diṅnāga. See Vidyabhushana, HIL. p. 50.
--Nyāyasūtras.
